base_rate_warning: a settlement-direction base rate over few windows can imitate skill, so each bin also reports the UP=yes share of its fill windows
candidate_grid: 1 Hz p_snapshot books, minimum 1.0s apart -- deliberately far denser than the frozen study's eight EARLY_FROM_T0 checkpoints, so that fill scarcity is measured at its most generous
external_btc_feed: NOT AVAILABLE and therefore OMITTED. The lead/lag feed probe rejected all four candidate venues, so no external spot or futures series exists for this tape. The only reference used is the venue's own authoritative index_price (raw.I == LRRR_XBT).
independence_note: overlapping states within one five-minute window are NOT independent trials; every interval is a window-level bootstrap (windows resampled whole) and every cell reports its distinct window count
label: GEMINI_MAKER_TOXICITY_SEPARABILITY_LANE3_V1
not_a_cancellation_sweep: no cancellation threshold is proposed, swept or tuned anywhere in this file; the deliverable is a separability verdict
resting_horizon: a hypothetical quote is left resting from its state until the window's expiry and is never cancelled or repriced. This is the MOST GENEROUS fill assumption available and is why the fill count far exceeds the frozen study's 0-for-7: that study quoted only at eight EARLY_FROM_T0 checkpoints, whereas this grid is 1 Hz. The evidence standard itself is unchanged. Note also that an inside-spread placement has little or no displayed size ahead of it, so the conservative queue is usually just our own contract -- the fills are cheap to earn and still lose money.

verdict.recommended_action: KILL the BTC5m maker hypothesis. No surviving variant is proposed and no cancellation threshold is swept: a cancel rule cannot help, because there is no non-toxic state for it to stay resting in.
verdict.statement: 10698 evidenced hypothetical fills across 46 distinct windows. 93.7% of fills are toxic. Some pre-fill features DO order states by how badly the fill turns out -- but EVERY bin of EVERY feature has an adverse-selection interval entirely BELOW zero. The least-toxic bin found anywhere is touch_depth=LOW at -0.10965 USD per contract (CI [-0.16047, -0.0852]), still strictly negative. Pre-fill information here ranks states from bad to worse and never identifies one worth supplying liquidity into, so toxic-versus-non-toxic is not a separation that exists to be made. The features that order the loss are additionally confounded with the settlement direction of the few windows behind each bin (each bin's UP=yes share is reported), which is exactly the base-rate trap, so even the ordering is weaker than it looks.
